title: QNET tasks Nigerian youths on ethical direct selling, entrepreneurship
text:
As Nigeria faces rising youth unemployment and increasing scrutiny of informal business models, trust has become the defining currency
and increasing scrutiny of informal business models, trust has become the defining currency of entrepreneurship. Against this backdrop, QNET, a global wellness and lifestyle company, is positioning ethical direct selling not as a quick income promise but as a regulated, transparent pathway into micro-entrepreneurship.
Operating in Nigeria since 2021 through independent distributors and digital sales channels, QNET stresses that legitimate direct selling relies on verifiable product sales rather than recruitment schemes. The firm said this distinction separates ethical direct selling from fraudulent operations that exploit vulnerable youth.
Speaking with the media yesterday on the just-completed VCON 2026 conference held in Malaysia, Regional General Manager, Central and West Africa, QNET, Cheriff Sarr, said direct selling offers ambitious individuals a chance to build independent businesses with minimal overhead. He said yet, the industry often faces public scepticism due to bad actors and unauthorised entities misusing prominent brand names to misrepresent business models.
He said to combat misconceptions, major global lifestyle and wellness direct-selling organisations, such as QNET, have reinforced zero-tolerance policies against unethical business practices. According to him, key protective measures central to this framework include absolute transparency, strict compliance, valid contract registration, accurate representation, among others. He said sustainable growth in direct marketing relies heavily on high-quality product offerings and scientific innovation.
“Recent industry conventions have underscored flagship innovations designed to meet contemporary consumer demands, spanning advanced water-purification systems, specialised grounding wellness mats, and luxury timepieces. , mobile applications, and supply chain visibility tools, independent distributors can operate efficiently while providing consumers with verified, accurate product information,” he stated.
